state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 3 (the call) is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk. The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs run` calls an extension end to end. Codegen emits `InstKind::ExtensionCall` as a variadic call of `nvs_runtime::extension::nvs_extension_call` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/extension.rs` module doc), and `nvs-cli`'s `extensions::Calls` hosts it over one `nvs_ext::call::Request` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc).

Every row of `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`'s table crosses both ways, resources included (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs` module doc). A guest that reaches a CPU or memory limit runs the request's `Core\Fatal::onLimit` handler, then is a `FATAL` (`tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-that-reaches-the-memory-limit-runs-the-limit-handler.nvst`).

**Still open in Stage 3:** `nvs serve` installs no `Calls`. Stage 4 (qualifiers) is the driver's earliest red check and has nothing written yet.

items.text: **`nvs serve` hosts extension calls**: install a `Calls` per request from the live set (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:165`), and run `Calls::end` when the request's tasks finish, so a resource is dropped at the request's end. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`, `rule:packaging/a-guest-crash-throws`.

**Then Stage 4, qualifiers**: a manifest's `tainted`/`secret` declarations reach the `MethodSig` fields a `Core` member's carry (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs:1`), so `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/quals.rs:1` refuses them with no extension branch. `rule:security/extension-manifest-only-tightens`.

backlog: `nvs test`, `nvs check` with the set, and the language server (Stage 6) — `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.
The source section and autoload (Stage 5) — ADR 0246 § 8.
